title.en: Fable 28 — The Ant and the Grasshopper

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: In summer the ant worked all day.

sentences.ar: היא אספה זרעים והכניסה אותם הביתה.
sentences.en: She gathered seeds and took them home.
The grasshopper sang and played in the sun.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר לה: יש עוד זמן.
sentences.en: He said to her: there is still time.
In winter it rained and it was cold.
The grasshopper was hungry and came to ask.
The ant said: in summer you sang.
